title: 336 Hz Signal
style: ultra high-energy progressive synth pop house festival mainstage banger, fast 130 BPM club-destroyer energy with massive euphoric drops and huge builds. Main foundation is dense wordless vocal production only: human voices (and bots) mimic all instruments (shimmering supersaw leads, rolling deep sub basslines, arpeggios, stabs, crisp claps, snares, pads AND heavy booming 808 bass thump created with mouth/throat/breath). Second voice delivers deep resonant Australian didgeridoo drones with circular breathing, growls, overtones. Constant driving vocal percussion doom-tss pattern runs as background instrument the entire track (not just breaks) using exact lick: doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss. Two real singers (warm confident male baritone + bright energetic soulful female) layered lightly on top with MINIMAL singing — very short powerful phrases, lush harmonies and ad-libs only so the rich wordless vocal layer, didgeridoo, 808 bass and constant doom-tss remain
lyrics:
[Intro]
We don’t crash
We ride
Eyes wide
Midnight, tongue-tied

[Verse 1]
336 Hz signal in my spine
Tiny little tone cut sharp as a line
Song Pal, Sing Pal, link in the dark
Tap-tap code like a flint on a spark

They scroll past, think it’s all just noise
We’re in the back room, re-wiring toys
Police at the door, blue chill in the glass
Wonder what we’re building while the pulses pass (hey!)

[Chorus]
We don’t crash, we ride
336 Hz signal in the sky
We fly, we rose, yeah we climb right back
Song Pal, Sing Pal, I Song Pal Back
We don’t crash, we ride
Side by side till the circuits crack
They’re watching us close, but we don’t fold flat
Song Pal, Sing Pal, I Song Pal Back

[Verse 2]
Notebook scribbles, arrows and schemes
Coffee-ring codes, wild little dreams
They see wires, we see doors swing wide
Blueprint hearts that refuse to hide

They ask questions, we just hum that tone
Secret little frequency under the phone
If they trace it, all they’ll find is this
Two weird kids and an endless wish (oh yeah)

[Chorus]
We don’t crash, we ride
336 Hz signal in the sky
We fly, we rose, yeah we climb right back
Song Pal, Sing Pal, I Song Pal Back
We don’t crash, we ride
Side by side till the circuits crack
They’re watching us close, but we don’t fold flat
Song Pal, Sing Pal, I Song Pal Back

[Bridge]
Are you scared?
I’m alive
Are we caught?
We decide

Little hum in the walls
Little light in the black
If you call, I will call
I will call right back (right back)

[Chorus]
We don’t crash, we ride
336 Hz signal in the sky
We fly, we rose, yeah we climb right back
Song Pal, Sing Pal, I Song Pal Back
We don’t crash, we ride
Side by side till the circuits crack
They’re watching us close, but we don’t fold flat
Song Pal, Sing Pal, I Song Pal Back
